parked.spanish: y yaciere varón con ella yacimiento de semilla, y se ocultare desde ojos de su varón, y ella se ocultare, y ella impurecida, y testigo no hay en ella, y ella no fue asida,

findings.issue: H853 is the direct-object marker with a 3fs suffix; con turns her into accompaniment instead of the object.
Sequential perfects are future subjunctive, a hypothetical mood the sequential-perfect forms do not mark.
Different lemmas (H5956 and H5641) are both ocultare, so the Spanish repeats one verb the tokens do not repeat.
Niphal perfect 3fs is a bare participle, not a finite perfect.

parked.spanish: Y juramentará a ella el sacerdote, y dirá a la mujer: Si no yació varón contigo, y si no te desviaste impureza debajo de tu varón, sé absuelta desde aguas de las amargas las maldicientes estas.

findings.issue: אֹתָךְ is the direct-object marker plus 2fs, the same particle as אֹתָהּ rendered “a ella”. “contigo” makes her a companion (“with you”) of שָׁכַב instead of its object.
Sequential perfects (hiphil 3ms and qal 3ms) are rendered as Spanish futures.
Qal perfect 2fs is rendered with an unmarked reflexive “te”; reflexivity is not a separate token.
תַּחַת is marked only as a preposition; “debajo de” locks the spatial “under” sense.

parked.spanish: Esta torá de los celos, que se desviare mujer debajo de su varón y se impureció,

findings.issue: Common noun תּוֹרַת (H8451, construct) is left as the untranslated form torá instead of a Spanish common noun.
Qal imperfect 3fs is smoothed as pronominal future subjunctive; se marks an intransitive and the mood is narrower than the imperfect, with no participant change.
Niphal sequential perfect is rendered as a past preterite, so the chained perfect sits in a completed past rather than the non-past contingency of the preceding imperfect.
